response.sql: WITH cust AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, spent, spent * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice) AS share FROM cust), avgs AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avgs a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
